title: Glowing cupcake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/glow beneath cupcake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <!-- cupcake wrapper -->
  <path d='M26 60 L34 86 Q50 92 66 86 L74 60 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- wrapper ridges -->
  <path d='M29 63 L36 85' stroke='#e09a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <path d='M41 63 L44 88' stroke='#e09a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 63 L50 88' stroke='#e09a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M59 63 L56 88' stroke='#e09a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M65 63 L60 87' stroke='#e09a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M71 63 L64 85' stroke='#e09a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='25' ry='10' fill='#ff8ad8'/>
  <!-- frosting swirls -->
  <path d='M27 58 Q30 42 38 44 Q42 30 50 32 Q58 28 62 42 Q72 40 73 56' fill='#ff8ad8'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='8' fill='#ffb3e8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='7' fill='#ff9fe0'/>
  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='6' fill='#ff3355'/>
  <!-- cherry highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='22' r='2' fill='#ff8899'/>
  <!-- cherry stem -->
  <path d='M50 18 Q53 12 56 10' stroke='#44cc66' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x='36' y='50' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffee44' transform='rotate(25 38 51)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='47' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#44ddff' transform='rotate(-20 58 48)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66ff88' transform='rotate(40 46 45)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffee44' transform='rotate(-35 64 54)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='56' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#44ddff' transform='rotate(15 34 57)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='52' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff6688' transform='rotate(-10 50 53)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='58' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66ff88' transform='rotate(50 56 59)'/>
  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#aaffff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#aaffff'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#ffaaff'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#ffaaff'/>
</svg>
